v1_release_blockers.highlight: 3-4 Geth PRs (thumbs-up'd but unmerged) are primary V1 release blockers; Chase pinged Marius and Felix
V1 release chain: Geth PRs → fix eSimulate V1 → upgrade to Glamsterdam → V1 spec release
Chase's Hive schema-validation PR likely superseded by Felix's more flexible Go-script approach (both WIP)

tracing_api_harmonization.highlight: Issue #890: clients have significant trace-output differences; no agreed spec; Geth only supports debug namespace, not trace
Geth unlikely to implement trace namespace until other clients converge on a unified spec
Proposed approach: write spec, produce per-client diff table (as done for OpCode Tracer), then open alignment PRs
No Trace V2 recommended; since no standard exists today, standardize in-place rather than versioning

error_codes.highlight: Error-code standardization blocked on eSimulate V1 legacy codes; recommendation: leave V1 alone, address in eSimulate V2
Simsonraj will own error-code push; plans to DM Felix directly to drive Geth implementation

action_items.action: Simsonraj to DM Felix and drive error-code standardization in Geth
Chase to consult Mantec and begin trace-namespace spec draft with per-client diff table; not prioritized until V1 ships
